sections.Profile:
"Pot 'O' Gold" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation on June 30, 1965. Designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by Jerry Kelley, the game features a nautical treasure-hunting theme, complete with divers and sea creatures. The playfield includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, and two rollunder lanes.
